visualCharacteristics.structure: large opening quote mark + accent rule, quotation text, attribution (portrait, name, role)

contentPattern: 3 rows, 1 cell each: [quotation richtext] | [author portrait image, optional] | [attribution richtext: name paragraph, role paragraph]; image and attribution optional
reuseGuidance: Use for source div.pullquote components in article bodies (pullquote-red maps to the default style, pullquote-blue to blue, pullquote-black to black). Not for testimonial carousels or long block quotes inside rich text.
